newsitem.title: EGYPT: Conference agenda for Middle East economic summit.
newsitem.headline: Conference agenda for Middle East economic summit.

text.p: Here are extracts from the agenda for the Middle East/North Africa Economic Conference from November 12-14 in Cairo (all times in GMT).
0900: Official opening of the conference with a speech by Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.
1300-1400: Plenary session -- Peace and Economic Development (Part 1).
1415-1545: Plenary session part 2 -- thematic sessions and project presentations in parallel. Project presentations by Morocco, Egypt, Qatar.
0700-0830: Plenary session. The economic climate -- policies and reforms needed to create an investor friendly environment.

0900-1030: Thematic sessions, project presentations and special workshops. Presentations by Tourism Committee, Regional Economic Development Working Group, summit secretariat, Jordan project presentation.
1245-1415: Thematic sessions and project presentations. Projects presented by Israel, the Palestinian Authority, Tunisia, the Peace Pipeline -- natural gas interconnections.
0730-0900: Plenary session -- Investment opportunities, potential, and challenges.
0930-1100: Thematic sessions and project presentations. Presentations on Taba-Eilat-Aqaba Macro Area, energy projects.
1400-1530: Sectoral workshops and project presentations in parallel. Project presentations for the Jordan Rift Valley, South Eastern Mediterranean Economic Development.
